Chapter 1119: Chapter 37: Lin Yuan and King Lingshen (Subscription Requested)

“It’s over.”

King Chijue was subdued, and similarly witnessed King Lingshen with a mere gesture confine all Great Venerables of the Purple Dream Domain within his palm.

Then slowly clenched his hand slightly.

King Lingshen, an evolved Core Royal to the extreme, could square off for a few moves against a true Heavenly Venerate, his strength far surpassing peak Great Venerables.

The five or six peak Great Venerables from the Purple Dream Domain, along with over twenty veteran Great Venerables, and several new Great Venerables, were utterly incapable of withstanding the grip of King Lingshen.

This is the terror of the Core Royals of the Ancient Countries; once their growth reaches the extreme, they practically carve out a new realm between Great Venerables and Heavenly Venerates.

Typically, in local wars between Ancient Countries, Core Royals who have grown to the extreme rarely appear.

These powerhouses, being nearly at the same tier as Heavenly Venerates, only reveal themselves in extremely intense large-scale wars, or total warfare.

The Spirit Might King’s initiation of war, including asking his brother King Lingshen to intervene, was an anticipated event.

But that King Lingshen had grown to the extreme caught King Chijue off guard, for Core Royals indeed have a unique advantage, yet reaching the extreme and fully excavating their Bloodline Power is a rare feat.

At least, King Chijue hadn’t achieved it over countless eons.

“Damn it.”

From the battlefield’s rear, Red Pine King shuddered as he saw all Great Venerables from his side lifted by a single hand of King Lingshen.

At this moment, he realized his prior order for all Great Venerables to retreat through the Space-Time Passage back to Qingfen City was a grave miscalculation.

The Core Royals who’ve reached the extreme are indeed powerful, with the peak Great Venerables standing no chance before them.

Yet, this extreme power of the Core Royals is merely formidable in presence, mundane in terms of suppression by rules.

The Purple Dream Domain’s more than twenty Great Venerable forces, originally dispersed across various battlefield lines, would be difficult for King Lingshen to hunt down individually even if they retreated to Qingfen City.

Not to mention that King Lingshen must also spare attention to suppress King Chijue.

But Red Pine King had all Great Venerables gather through the Space-Time Passage? That was akin to placing all Great Venerables in one spot, thus providing King Lingshen an opportunity to net them all.

Just like trying to catch dozens of big fish scattered across a pond, demanding considerable effort, and possibly letting some slip away.

Yet when all big fish are gathered in a region, a simple sweep with a net will suffice.

“Defeated.”

Red Pine King looked upward towards a higher space-time, although he couldn’t see the exact scene, he knew all Great Venerables had fallen into King Lingshen’s hands, their fate almost inevitable.

Surely, these Great Venerables have means of preserving their lives, even if they perish, they wouldn’t be completely obliterated.

But losing a primary battle form, these Great Venerables wouldn’t be able to act for quite a long time.

After all, regathering a peak state primary battle form isn’t easy, not to mention the loss of intimate weaponry, finding perfect substitutes in the short term would be difficult.

And to sum it up.

Even if they could act, it would be too late; King Lingshen would surely rush to Qingfen City at the fastest speed and seize it by absolute strength.

Once Qingfen City falls, the Qingfen Domain essentially collapses, almost declaring the failure of the war.

“Who would have thought this war ended so swiftly?”

Red Pine King remained silent, primarily due to his misjudgment of King Lingshen’s strength.

Before this, King Lingshen had never publicly declared his growth to the extreme.

…

Compared to Red Pine King, King Chijue’s burden, the Spirit Might King, who also observed the battlefield situation, was instead consumed by ecstasy.

“Sorted.”

The Spirit Might King was assured within himself, even if he already knew beforehand that his brother had reached the extreme of the Core Royals.

Yet on a battlefield, countless variables could lead to unexpected turns, perhaps King Chijue might have reached the extreme?

Or King Chijue might possess a hidden trump weapon capable of resisting the extreme Core Royals.

The variables and surprises are too numerous.

But now?

With King Lingshen capturing all enemy Great Venerables in one grasp, the battlefield’s end was basically announced.

Even as news from the battlefield reached the Fierce Sun Ancient Country’s capital, and powerhouses similar to King Lingshen rushed to the battlefield, it would be far too late.

The distance between the Fierce Sun capital and Qingfen Domain is unknown, even a Heavenly Venerate couldn’t arrive immediately, and even with Qingfen City’s Space-Time Passage, a short time is needed.

Which is enough for King Lingshen to reach Qingfen City.

…

In the higher space-time.

King Lingshen, originally assured of victory, looked at his half-clenched right hand with a subtle shift in expression.

‘World in Palm’ was one of his Bloodline Talents, forming a world within his palm that would begin to collapse as he closed his fingers.

The ensuing destructive force from the world’s collapse couldn’t be withstand by even a peak Great Venerable.

This method proved little against rivals of similar tier, yet to those weaker, it was an ultimate weapon.

Yet now, King Lingshen’s face was somber, clearly sensing a force preventing his fingers from closing.

Accurately speaking, it wasn’t hindering the closing of his fingers, but the collapse of the world within his grip.

The originally haikus about to be completely annihilated world was supported by an invisible force, rendering King Lingshen’s fingers unable to clasp shut.

“Who is it?”

King Lingshen furrowed his brows, from among the many Great Venerables suppressed within his World in Palm, undoubtedly the strongest were those few peak Great Venerables— Great Venerate Hongye, Fire Axe Great Venerable, Lord Qingfen, etc.
